summary: REZI 10-K is unusually honest for a name that has drawn down -24%. Standard distress markers are all negative: no going-concern language, Big-4 Deloitte continuous since 2018 spin-off with zero disagreements, full covenant compliance, $500M revolver fully undrawn, term loan repriced down THREE times in 2024 (margin 2.25% -> 1.75%), and 6.5% Senior Notes refinancing — these are lender-confidence signals, not distress. The two genuine drag items (Honeywell Reimbursement Agreement at $140M/yr cap through 2043 with growing $723M liability, and the structural 47.8% ETR from non-deductible indemnification) are fully disclosed and quantified. The Mode B insider check is the dominant finding: 2025 YTD Form 4 ledger shows ZERO discretionary insider sales and TWO open-market PURCHASES — Chairman Teich (18,154 sh @ $19.29) days after the 10-K, and CD&R Channel Holdings II ($100M, 5.75M sh @ $17.38) six days before our cutoff. The Snap One acquisition (-18% ADI segment OI, immaterial OI contribution in 2024) is the legitimate operating concern but the 10-K does not hide it. Q1-25 10-Q reaffirms FY guidance.
